entries.title: Audit an executive calendar after a time-zone rule change
entries.topic: How should a Filipino assistant find and repair meetings affected by a changed time-zone rule without silently changing commitments?
entries.readerOutcome: Produce an impact list that separates safe display corrections from owner decisions.
entries.workedExample: A recurring New York–Manila review crosses a daylight-saving transition while one attendee travels to Arizona.

entries.title: Handle a suspicious attachment in a shared inbox
entries.topic: What can an inbox assistant record and route when an attachment looks suspicious, and which actions must stay with security owners?
entries.readerOutcome: Preserve message evidence and keep the queue moving without opening, forwarding, or diagnosing the file.
entries.workedExample: A familiar supplier sends an unexpected archive while an invoice deadline is approaching.

entries.title: Check a traveler name before a booking is issued
entries.topic: How can a travel-planning assistant compare the approved traveler profile with a booking record while minimizing identity-data exposure?
entries.readerOutcome: Catch a name mismatch before ticketing and escalate corrections to the authorized traveler or travel manager.
entries.workedExample: A traveler uses a shortened first name internally but the approved profile includes two given names.

entries.title: Freeze the right pre-read version before a meeting
entries.topic: What evidence should a meeting-preparation assistant capture when contributors keep editing a pre-read near the distribution deadline?
entries.readerOutcome: Distribute one traceable version while preserving late changes for an authorized owner to resolve.
entries.workedExample: Finance changes a chart after the chair approved distribution but before two external attendees receive the pack.

entries.title: Prepare evidence before merging duplicate CRM accounts
entries.topic: Which fields, relationships, and downstream effects should a CRM assistant compare before an owner approves a duplicate-account merge?
entries.readerOutcome: Build a reversible merge brief without deciding customer identity from a name match alone.
entries.workedExample: Two similarly named companies share a domain after an acquisition but retain different contracts and contacts.

entries.title: Decide when a research source is too old for the question
entries.topic: How should a research assistant evaluate whether an older authoritative source still supports a current operational claim?
entries.readerOutcome: Separate enduring guidance from changeable facts and record a defensible freshness decision.
entries.workedExample: A respected five-year-old remote-work report is used beside a current platform-security claim.

entries.title: Check a document redaction before external release
entries.topic: What should a document-formatting assistant inspect to confirm that visible masking, metadata, and accessible text do not expose restricted content?
entries.readerOutcome: Prepare a release copy for owner approval without treating a black rectangle as completed redaction.
entries.workedExample: A proposal PDF hides customer names visually, but copied text and file properties still contain them.

entries.title: Plan for an absent project dependency owner
entries.topic: How can a project-coordination assistant surface decisions that will stall during a named owner's absence without inventing delegated authority?
entries.readerOutcome: Create a coverage map for routine updates, approvals, and stop conditions before leave begins.
entries.workedExample: A launch depends on a legal sign-off and a vendor credential while both owners overlap on leave.

entries.title: Record the exchange-rate source for an expense
entries.topic: What should an expense assistant preserve when the receipt, card statement, and policy use different currencies or conversion dates?
entries.readerOutcome: Reconcile arithmetic and provenance while leaving accounting-policy choices with the authorized owner.
entries.workedExample: A hotel charges euros, the corporate card posts dollars two days later, and the report is reimbursed in pesos.

entries.title: Review candidate rescheduling consistently
entries.topic: How should a recruitment-scheduling assistant apply a written reschedule rule while preserving exceptions for an authorized hiring owner?
entries.readerOutcome: Keep scheduling records consistent without making suitability or accommodation decisions.
entries.workedExample: Two candidates request a second change for different reasons after the panel calendar is rearranged.

entries.title: Resolve conflicting customer contact preferences
entries.topic: What should a follow-up assistant do when the CRM, support ticket, and latest customer message disagree about the preferred channel?
entries.readerOutcome: Pause the risky outreach, preserve the newest evidence, and route consent or policy decisions correctly.
entries.workedExample: The CRM says phone, a ticket says email only, and the latest reply asks for no calls this week.

entries.title: Detect metric-definition drift in an operations report
entries.topic: How can a reporting assistant identify when a familiar metric name now counts different events, populations, or time windows?
entries.readerOutcome: Prevent a misleading trend comparison by reconciling definitions before refreshing the dashboard.
entries.workedExample: Response time changes from first human reply to any automated acknowledgement halfway through the quarter.
